name: Necromancer: both Rotting Flesh passives work - hasted Flesh to Worms +25%, minion buff (#1814)
contract: #1814 names two different spells called Rotting Flesh. (1) The Death talent 301304 (CharacterAdvancement 7808, Tab 59) reads 'Increases the damage of Flesh to Worms by $s1% and allows its periodic damage to scale with your spell haste.' In SpellFamilyName 29, effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) MiscValue 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT), BasePoints 24 + DieSides 1 = +25%, and effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HASTE (316); both use class mask (0x4000, 0, 0), which selects every Flesh to Worms rank (500338, 501855-501861; family flags 0x4000, 0, 0x20). Flesh to Worms 500338 is a PERIODIC_DAMAGE aura ticking every 3000 ms with no SPELL_ATTR5_SPELL_HASTE_AFFECTS_PERIODIC. Both auras are native: Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone applies SPELLMOD_DOT to periodic damage, and AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic multiplies the period by UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED when the caster has aura 316 for the spell; the Necromancer contracts dummy only auras 42 and 354. Icy Veins 12472 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CASTING_SPEED_NOT_STACK +20%) is the haste fixture: without the talent a Flesh to Worms still ticks every 3000 ms, with it a fresh one ticks every 3000 x cast speed multiplier (about 2500 ms), and the periodic damage bonus from a fixed base rises by exactly 25%. (2) The level 30 passive 574138 (CharacterAdvancement 9223, RequiredLevel 30) reads 'Applying Crypt Plague to an enemy now additionally adds Rotting Flesh to your Undead minions, increasing their damage dealt by $573131s1% per stack for $/1000;s1 sec.' Its gating and five-second duration were fixed by 55a017c7a (#295, scenario necromancer-rotting-flesh-level-passive), which checks the owner's aura only. The buff 573131's effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS (190) with SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE +2, so it reaches the owner's summons natively; with Crypt Plague 92121 (Crypt Swarm damage applies Crypt Plague 570131) a raised Lesser Skeletal Warrior 50065 must carry 573131. The audit's premise (no source reference to 301304 or 574138) does not apply: 301304 is native and 574138 is read in AscensionNecromancer::Plague.
